experiment: PoL2 state-variable counterfactual transfer and invariance test

design.train_test_split: held-out instruction phrase families and entity/target identities; the balanced 384-row training sample contains only a subset of the full state-family grid
design.pair_generation: all pairs differing in exactly one state-family variable within the same instruction family
estimands: directional response when the contract-preferred action changes
prediction invariance when the preferred action does not change

limitations: This is a post-training mechanistic behavioral diagnostic, not a fresh independent normative benchmark.
The tested contract is a narrow synthetic embodied-action slice, not complete PoL2.
Train and test share state-axis values; only phrase families and entity/target identities are held out.
Labels are generated by the same executable contract that defines the target; the study cannot validate that operationalization itself.
Output behavior and counterfactual consistency do not establish private representations, subjective understanding, or all-theory possession.
